content.text:
TASK:
Record the UPDATE MEMBER INFORMATION capability against MERIDIAN CORE. (1) Sign on. (2) Member Inquiry -> search by Member Number for the memberId parameter -> Select. (3) Click 'Update Member Information'. (4) Type the email parameter into the E-mail field, the phone parameter into Phone, and the address parameter into Mailing Address. (5) Click 'Save Changes' - this modifies the member record, so mark it irreversible=true (a human pre-authorised this recording). (6) Confirm the update succeeded, then declare_done with capability_id 'member.updateInfo'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "103001"
- email (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'email'. — value: "***om"
- phone (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'phone'. — value: "***99"
- address (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'address'. — value: "***ay"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MERIDIAN CORE application to begin sign on.

input.title: Update Member Information
input.description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, searches Member Inquiry by Member Number for the given memberId, selects the record, and opens Update Member Information. Types the email, phone, and address parameters into the E-mail, Phone, and Mailing Address fields and clicks Save Changes (an irreversible record modification). Confirms success via the 'CHANGES SAVED' / 'MEMBER INFORMATION UPDATED' screen (outcome UPDATE_SAVED). Inputs: memberId, email, phone, address, plus operatorId/operatorPassword resolved from the environment.
